doc.title: Carter Benny — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Teddy Wilson's first record date with Carter, the Chocolate Dandies
summary: Within a day or two of his return, the group recorded Once Upon a Time and others.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: And when you came back, I believe the next day, you were already in the studio with Teddy Wilson back in New York.
I think it was within a day or two.

Yeah, that [unclear] . . . maybe that’s why the sense of urgency with which we went after him, because we were . . . and actually, I think that was for a recording session that Hammond had set up and probably produced. So that’s probably why.
Right. That was the Chocolate Dandies date.
Right, and Once Upon a Time and a couple of other things, yeah.
And his playing on that certainly made everyone understand why you were so enthusiastic about him.
